_comment: System 1, J6: real ticket texts for the privacy question, checked by hand on 2026-11-15. Each text was masked with nobody allowed (strangersOnly), as in use, and read for a name that survived. ft-2, trained only on synthetic sentences, held 46 of these 185 texts with no name at 0.7, and caught one of the three with a name. 'namesAPerson': the masking left a person's name (FAR-15 'Ferrari Giulia', BIL-17 'Bianchi' and 'Ricci', LAB-19 'Romano'). 'noPerson': the masking left none. A Jira ticket in neither list is not used for this question, so a new ticket is never labelled without a person reading it. The written tickets (written-tickets.json) name nobody and are all 'no person'.
